MISSING_CAPITAL.title: Starting capital required
MISSING_CAPITAL.message: Set the account's starting capital before the Coach can calculate targets, risk, and drawdown.

OPEN_TRADE_WITHOUT_STOP.title: Open risk is unknown
OPEN_TRADE_WITHOUT_STOP.message: {{count}} active trades do not have complete stop or quantity data. Total open risk cannot be calculated reliably.

NO_ADDITIONAL_RISK_CAPACITY.title: No additional risk capacity
NO_ADDITIONAL_RISK_CAPACITY.message: Existing open positions already use the available risk budget. Opening another trade would exceed the account plan.

DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED.title: Daily limit reached
DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED.message: The daily loss limit has been reached. The Coach recommends no additional trades today.

TARGET_REACHED.title: Monthly target reached
TARGET_REACHED.message: The monthly target has been reached. Consider reducing risk and protecting the result rather than forcing additional trades.

TARGET_EXCEEDED.title: Target exceeded
TARGET_EXCEEDED.message: You are {{amountAboveTarget}} above the monthly target. Additional risk is no longer required to complete the plan.

MONTH_NOT_STARTED.title: No realised result this month
MONTH_NOT_STARTED.message: No realised trades have been closed this month. Your monthly target is {{targetPct}}% or {{targetAmount}}.

ON_TRACK.title: On track
ON_TRACK.message: You have completed {{progressPct}}% of the monthly target and remain on track at your normal trading pace.

BEHIND_BUT_RECOVERABLE.title: Behind, but recoverable
BEHIND_BUT_RECOVERABLE.message: You are behind the planned trajectory, but the target remains achievable without increasing standard risk.

BEHIND_UNREALISTIC.title: Required pace is outside the normal range
BEHIND_UNREALISTIC.message: Reaching the remaining target would require {{requiredR}}R in {{daysRemaining}} trading days, which is outside your normal performance range.

DO_NOT_INCREASE_TO_CATCH_UP.title: Do not increase risk to catch up
DO_NOT_INCREASE_TO_CATCH_UP.message: The account is behind target, but increasing risk would materially increase the probability of breaching the plan.

OPEN_PROFIT_NOT_REALIZED.title: Open profit is not realised
OPEN_PROFIT_NOT_REALIZED.message: Open trades currently add {{floatingPnL}} to equity, but this profit is not realised and is not counted as completed target progress.

OPEN_LOSS_REDUCES_BUFFER.title: Open loss reduces the buffer
OPEN_LOSS_REDUCES_BUFFER.message: Current open losses reduce the available drawdown buffer by {{bufferReduction}}. Review exposure before opening another trade.

REDUCE_RISK.title: Reduced risk recommended
REDUCE_RISK.message: Reduce risk from {{currentRiskPct}}% to approximately {{recommendedRiskPct}}% until drawdown and execution quality stabilise.

STANDARD_RISK.title: Current risk recommendation
STANDARD_RISK.message: The current recommended risk is {{riskPct}}% or {{riskAmount}} per trade.

LOSING_STREAK.title: Losing streak protection
LOSING_STREAK.message: You have recorded {{lossCount}} consecutive losses. Historical data supports reduced risk until compliant execution stabilises.

NEGATIVE_EXPECTANCY.title: Target not statistically supported
NEGATIVE_EXPECTANCY.message: Current expectancy is {{expectancyR}}R per trade. The monthly target is not statistically supported without improving trade selection or execution.

POSITIVE_EXPECTANCY.title: Positive measured R expectancy
POSITIVE_EXPECTANCY.message: The selected projection dataset currently produces an expectancy of {{expectancyR}}R per trade.

NO_VALID_R_SAMPLE.title: R sample unavailable
NO_VALID_R_SAMPLE.message: Closed trades exist, but no valid initial-risk outcomes are available for the projection. Monetary results remain separate.

NO_CLOSED_TRADES.title: No closed-trade sample
NO_CLOSED_TRADES.message: No closed trades are available for this account. Add or import trades before using performance-based projections.

LOW_SAMPLE_SIZE.title: Low sample size
LOW_SAMPLE_SIZE.message: Only {{tradeCount}} valid trades are available. The current projection has low statistical confidence.

INCONSISTENT_PNL.title: P&L inconsistencies detected
INCONSISTENT_PNL.message: {{count}} trades have P&L values that do not match the available reconciliation data. Recommendations have reduced confidence.

COSTS_MATERIAL.title: Costs are material
COSTS_MATERIAL.message: Trading costs represent {{costPct}}% of gross profit and reduce expectancy by {{costR}}R per trade.

corePricing.entryExitBody: Prices for entering and exiting the trade plus optional stop-loss and take-profit anchors.

pnlAndRisk.feesCostsBody: All trading costs deducted from gross P&L.
pnlAndRisk.pnlGrossBody: Signed price delta × quantity before costs. Futures and similar contracts also apply the contract multiplier or point value (for example MNQ uses $2 per point, or $0.50 per 0.25 tick).
pnlAndRisk.pnlNetBody: P&L gross minus fees, commission, and slippage. Risk amount only affects R-multiple; it does not change net P&L.
pnlAndRisk.pnlPercentBody: Net P&L divided by capital used, expressed as a percentage. Risk amount does not change net P&L or replace this denominator.
pnlAndRisk.riskAmountPercentBody: Risk amount is the cash you are willing to lose if the stop-loss is hit. Risk % is risk amount divided by capital used when capital used is available.
pnlAndRisk.rMultipleBody: Net P&L divided by risk amount. If risk amount is blank, R multiple stays blank. 1R equals the initial cash risk.

EXACT_MATCH.label: Exact match

filters.title: Trade filters
filters.searchTrades: Search trades, setups, tags, or notes

INSUFFICIENT_DATA.label: Insufficient data
INSUFFICIENT_DATA.description: Fewer than 5 completed trades; no edge conclusion is supported.

EXPLORATORY.label: Exploratory
EXPLORATORY.description: 5–9 completed trades; use findings only to guide further testing.

EARLY_SIGNAL.label: Early signal
EARLY_SIGNAL.description: 10–29 completed trades; a signal may exist but remains sensitive to variance.

DEVELOPING_EDGE.label: Developing edge
DEVELOPING_EDGE.description: 30–49 completed trades with enough evidence for cautious comparison.

VALIDATED_EVIDENCE.label: Validated evidence
VALIDATED_EVIDENCE.description: At least 50 completed trades with non-negative expectancy and no material review flags.

NEEDS_REVIEW.label: Needs review
NEEDS_REVIEW.description: Negative expectancy, unresolved evidence, or material live/historical divergence needs attention.

VERY_LOW.label: Very low
VERY_LOW.description: The sample or classification coverage is too limited for confident conclusions.

LOW.label: Low
LOW.description: Some evidence exists, but source diversity or sample quality is limited.

MODERATE.label: Moderate
MODERATE.description: The sample, source diversity, and consistency support cautious conclusions.

HIGH.label: High
HIGH.description: A broad, classified sample shows stable and consistent evidence across sources.

prepare.cash: Cash index chart; not a CFD or futures contract.
prepare.aiUnavailable: AI interpretation and conditional scenarios unavailable: no associated market dataset.

prepare.notesOnly: These notes are saved in your preparation. They are not drawings or synced chart annotations.
